entries.title: Liquid channel
items: The channel you're in now fills with a rolling wave in your accent colours, rising in when you switch channels.
Prefer the old look? Layout → Selected channel look → Solid.

entries.title: Leonida and a start-up screen
items: New colourway: Leonida, sunset pink and orange over deep indigo.
Lighthouse start-up screen: a lighthouse with a sweeping beam, in your colourway and heading font. Needs OpenAsar (the tune-up script installs it).

entries.title: Rockstar fonts and rounded window
items: New text font: Rockstar (Chalet, as in GTA V's menus).
New heading font: Pricedown, the GTA logo font.
If they aren't installed on your PC, Lighthouse uses Archivo and Anton, the closest free fonts.
Rounded window corners, with a size slider (Title Bar settings).
Bookmark item now sits next to Discord's own Bookmark Message.

entries.title: Icons, notes, bookmarks and more
items: Fixed self-updates: they now save into your plugins folder.
Matching line icons on the main buttons (header, user panel, message box, title bar).
Channel notes: a notepad for each channel, opened from the channel header.
Bookmarks: right-click a message → Save to Lighthouse bookmarks, then find it in Ctrl+K.
Spotify buttons on the now-playing pill (needs Spotify Premium).
Share your setup with a code, or paste a friend's.
Server banner glow, embeds as cards, calmer role colours.
Breakage alerts if a Discord update stops Lighthouse finding something.

entries.title: Restyle everywhere, and updates from GitHub
items: Settings, right-click menus, tooltips, pickers, dialogs, the friends page, calls and forums restyled.
Colourway dot and quick picker in the title bar, shortcut sheet on Ctrl+Shift+/.
Server folders open as a tray under the strip.
Lighthouse now updates itself from GitHub.
